title: Dijkstra's Algorithm
subtitle: Find the shortest path from a source node to all other nodes in a weighted graph with non-negative edge weights.
complexity: Time: O(E log V) with priority queue
complexityNote: Only works with non-negative edge weights.
steps: Set distance to source = 0, all others = ∞
Pick unvisited node with smallest distance
For each neighbor, check if path through current is shorter
Update distance if shorter path found (relaxation)
Mark current node as finalized; repeat until all visited
